description: Metadata for public Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy pages on www.mpi-sp.org and mpi-sp.org. AI, machine-learning, security-research, news, and publication HTML pages are eligible. Rows keep a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies are not stored. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded GET that returned HTML and stayed on those hosts. robots.txt states no disallow. An HTML document in place of robots.txt does not allow a fetch. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. runner_wired is false.
